Located in the magical neighborhood of The Marvin Beach Association, this delightful, impeccably maintained home offers the perfect blend of classic cottage charm and modern comfort. But this home is more than a house-it's part of a vibrant coastal community where seaside lobster dinners, festive block parties, and friendly gatherings beachside are all part of the lifestyle where every day feels like a vacation. The Association offers 3 beaches and a private marina. Surrounded by lush seaside gardens, every inch of this property invites relaxation and connection with nature and sea! The large, screened porch offering an additional 192 sq ft with glass inserts for colder weather is the perfect place to enjoy the water views and breathtaking sunsets!. Inside, enjoy a large living room w/ fireplace that opens to the dining room with beautiful built-ins. Dining room opens to kitchen and private backyard oasis. Gardens bloom through the season, offering a picture-perfect setting for morning coffee, lazy afternoons, or evening cocktails under the stars. Enjoy peace of mind with newly updated systems throughout.
